title: Quiet Ember
description: A deep burgundy column cut from soft crush, a fabric that holds a fine, irregular texture and never falls flat. The tone deepens where the folds gather, so the silhouette reads as one long, unbroken line. Long sleeves, full length, and a weight that moves rather than swings.

title: Amber Hour
description: Warm auburn in a smooth matte weave, cut straight through the body with a gentle release at the hem. The colour sits between rust and cinnamon and shifts with the light rather than the angle. An everyday piece that carries itself like an occasion one.

title: Mulberry Veil
description: A mulberry base layered with chiffon, so the outer surface floats a fraction behind the body as you turn. The two weights read as a single depth of colour from a distance and separate only in movement. Cut long and generous through the sleeve.

title: Open Sky
description: A pale, clear blue in a fluid weave that keeps its shape without stiffness. The lightness of the tone makes the cut do the work — a clean shoulder, a long sleeve, and a hem that widens only slightly. Daylight dressing, unfussy.

title: Dusk Velvet
description: Velvet in a cool silver-grey, where the pile catches light along every fold and turns the colour twice over. Heavier than it looks, and it hangs accordingly — a straight, weighted fall from shoulder to floor. For the colder end of the year.

title: Second Nature
description: Black jersey, cut close to the way the body actually moves. The knit gives where it needs to and recovers, which makes this the piece that gets worn on the days nothing else does. Long sleeve, full length, no ceremony.

title: First Light
description: A soft rose in a cotton-blend weave with a dry, matte surface that keeps the colour quiet rather than sweet. It creases the way natural fibre does and settles again as you wear it. Cut roomy through the sleeve and long through the body.

title: Still Water
description: A closed-front abaya in pale mint, the body weighted and the overlay in chiffon so the outline stays soft at the edges. Slips on overhead and falls straight. The green is cool enough to read almost grey in shade.

title: Nightfall Lace
description: Navy with lace worked through the surface, so the depth of the colour is broken by a finer pattern that only resolves up close. The base holds the line; the lace softens it. An evening piece that does not announce itself from across a room.

title: Soft Static
description: Korean nida in a muted mink, layered with chiffon at the outer edge. Nida gives the piece its structure and its dry, even finish; the chiffon takes the hardness off the silhouette. A neutral that sits warmer than grey and cooler than beige.

title: Pomegranate Dark
description: A red so deep it reads black until it moves into light, cut in Korean nida for a clean, weighted fall. The fabric's matte finish keeps the colour dense rather than glossy. Straight through the body, long in the sleeve.

title: Saffron Light
description: Organza in a warm saffron, with the faint sheen that only organza gives — light sits on the surface and slides off as you turn. The body is generous and the sleeve gathers softly at the wrist. The most vivid piece in the collection, and it knows it.

title: Champagne Hour
description: A closed-front abaya in pale champagne, worked in a fine mesh that reads solid at distance and open up close. The colour is warm without being yellow, and it takes gold jewellery well. Cut long, with a full sweep at the hem.

title: Ash Rose
description: Organza silk in a greyed rose — the pink is dulled down until it behaves like a neutral. Silk gives the organza more body than usual, so the piece keeps its shape through the skirt instead of collapsing. Quiet, and expensive-looking about it.

title: Dove Grey
description: A clean mid-grey in a fine polyester weave that resists creasing and holds a sharp line at the shoulder. The colour is true neutral — no blue cast, no warmth — which makes it the easiest piece here to build around. Long sleeve, straight fall.

title: Winter Bloom
description: A wide, winged silhouette in deep burgundy, the sleeve opening into a long chiffon fall that trails as you move. Fine crystal scatter across the body and a worked cuff at each wrist catch the light in passing. The most ceremonial cut in the collection.

title: Dark Roast
description: A deep coffee brown in Korean nida, matte throughout and warm enough to soften against the skin. Brown behaves differently to black here — it recedes rather than blocks. Cut straight, long through the sleeve, weighted at the hem.

title: Faded Lilac
description: Lilac pulled most of the way to grey, in a nida weave that keeps the surface flat and the colour honest. It reads as a neutral in low light and as a soft violet in daylight. A restrained piece with an unusual colour at its centre.

title: Harbour Blue
description: A muted, slightly grey blue in Korean nida — the shade of water under cloud. The matte finish keeps it calm and stops the colour from turning pastel. Straight cut, long sleeve, clean at the shoulder.

title: Overcast
description: A soft warm grey in nida, cut plainly and finished plainly, which is the entire point. Nothing here competes with what you put over it. The hem falls straight and holds its line through a full day of wear.

title: Black Organza
description: A closed-front abaya in black organza, where the sheen sits on the surface and gives the black a depth flat weaves cannot reach. Slips overhead and falls in a full, unbroken column. The formal answer to the plain black abaya.

title: Rose Ash
description: A dusty rose in Korean nida, warm but muted enough to wear in daylight without drawing a crowd. The nida keeps the surface even and the fall straight. Long through the body, generous through the sleeve.

title: Deep Emerald
description: A saturated green in Korean nida — the deepest colour in the collection after the burgundies. The matte weave holds the tone without turning it glassy, so the green stays rich rather than bright. Cut long and straight.

title: Midnight Line
description: Navy taken almost to black, in a nida weave with a completely flat finish. In most light it passes for black; in direct light the blue surfaces. A straight, quiet cut for people who wear black and want one degree away from it.

title: Desert Stone
description: A warm sand beige in Korean nida, matte and even, with none of the yellow that beige usually carries. It reads as light without reading as pale, and it holds a clean line from shoulder to hem. The most wearable neutral here.
